title: Whole transport narratives with globally shared safety and weight-capacity semantics
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Alcuin-attributed Propositiones XVIII and XIX supply complete transport narratives whose meanings constrain every intermediate distribution, vehicle location, cargo identity and final safe state. A swapped first/third cargo preserves all cargo counts and the terminal inventory but leaves an unsafe unattended pair. A separate source problem distinguishes a weight-limited boat from a two-passenger count rule. Variable complete narratives need not copy either source sequence or its seven/nine crossing counts.

design.mechanism: One shared semantic language declares transport agents and cargo, vehicle capacity, initial locations, compatibility restrictions and a goal. Crossing clauses update both vehicle and passenger locations; later references use the same identity. Loading requires co-location. All intermediate unattended shore states satisfy fixed compatibility rules. A second clause type can assert or explain a capacity/safety condition without producing a movement. Failed hypothetical branches must be grammatically marked rather than executed in the actual-world state. This is a prospective content language, not a frozen cipher serializer.
design.unit: A whole problem/instruction/solution account, including initial conditions, every real or explicitly hypothetical movement, its explanations and final-state claim. The source owns the complete narratives XVIII and XIX; future texts may express different legal paths under the same semantic rules. No free extra voyage, disappearance, fresh-copy cargo, or per-record reset is allowed.
design.contrast: IDEA000140 already proposes chess-family legal move narratives; its complete proposal was read. This new content has a single shared vehicle, safety of unattended co-located objects and load-weight constraints, rather than alternating players, square coordinates, captures or check. The old complete-game card is not re-added. The itinerary-versus-static-station proposal already supplies location continuity, but does not supply the same all-states incompatibility and mass-capacity restrictions. P06/IDEA000124 retain endpoint and identity gaps; endpoint inventory alone is deliberately insufficient here.
design.prediction: A globally shared decode must make every stated voyage executable and every unmarked actual intermediate state safe. In XVIII the documented complete safe path has cargo sequence G,empty,W,G,C,empty,G with alternating outward/return directions. Exchanging cargo of trips1and3 keeps cargo counts and final state fixed but violates the G-C unattended prohibition immediately. In XIX a count-only two-passenger rival permits one adult plus one child, while the written positive child weight and adult=capacity require overload. A future target contrast must use this kind of raw differing consequence under one shared grammar, not a subjective narrative resemblance.

source_examples.whole_boundaries: Printed PL101 columns1149–1150, from Homo quidam debebat through absque voragine lacerationis; entire problem and solution on extracted PDFpage4.
source_examples.initial: Man, wolf, goat and cabbage at initial shore; boat holds at most two of these including man; all must arrive undamaged.
formalization_assumptions: Unattended wolf-goat and goat-cabbage pairings are forbidden. The problem asserts absence of damage but does not explicitly list these two dietary axioms.
The safety graph alone treats wolf and cabbage as exchangeable endpoint roles.
source_examples.source_only_check: Exact state replay gives all7source states safe. Cargo-swap rival reaches the same final inventory but its first state is unsafe.

source_examples.whole_boundaries: Printed PL101 column1150, entire De viro et muliere problem and solution, ending forsitan sine naufragio.
source_examples.initial: Each adult weighs one loaded-wagon unit; the two children together weigh one unit; boat capacity one unit. Children need not each weigh exactly half.
source_owned_constraints: Each child can row as enacted by the solution
source_examples.rival: Replace weight capacity by passenger-count capacity2; this admits adult+child despite positive child mass making that load exceed1.

source_receipt.native_vision: Complete PDFpage4 actually viewed; no OCR used to fabricate manuscript characters.
source_receipt.date_policy: Work traditionally attributed to Alcuin; BLB CodAugperg205 catalogue dates a manuscript containing the work to the last third of tenth century. Migne PL101 published1851/reprinted1863; extracted scan impression not identified. Medieval witness leaves not collated.

symmetries: Reverse both shores and every direction.
Exchange the two children under the stated total-weight constraints.
Exchange wolf/cabbage under undirected incompatibility alone; literal food names remain unbound.
design.scope: The externally owned examples establish semantic restrictions, not a Voynich boat scene or a decipherment. Full target owner/grammar, rule vocabulary and treatment of explanatory prose are unresolved. No requirement that a known word precede a joint hypothesis. No recommendation to fit arbitrary paths to paragraphs; grammar capacity and all surviving symmetries would need separate predeclared accounting.
design.writing_model_limits: No source token count, event count, fixed decimal/opcode fields, note-per-word rule, or literal source-order copy is equated with a target paragraph. A globally shared variable-length grammar must account for every content clause and reference within its declared whole-text scope. Explanations and exceptions cannot become free padding. Grammar productions and their written realization remain to be designed before a fit.
design.structural_dependencies: Retain hierarchy at spaces, directed composition, whole-form residuals and position/entry effects from the live baseline. EVA/BPE units are not an identified alphabet. No default Latin/phonetic basis, free deletion of wrappers, or arbitrary per-occurrence semantics.
design.ownership_limit: No complete admitted target owner and shared writing rule are nominated in this source-only card. Joint exploratory owner/code hypotheses remain allowed without a confirmed word; missing concrete observable consequence is a design gap, not a failed manuscript test or proof of absence.
